children: Overview
Dry bulk carrier's Q3 revenue fell 9% yr/yr amid Arabian Gulf disruptions
Q3 net profit surged to $24.5 mln from $82,000 a year earlier
Company contracted two Ultramax newbuildings in Q3, bringing 2026 orders to eight
Outlook
Company says dry bulk market conditions remain tight due to Arabian Gulf conflict and transit restrictions
Jinhui Shipping expects to receive thirteen Ultramax newbuildings between 2027 and 2030
Result Drivers
GEOPOLITICAL DISRUPTIONS - Co said Arabian Gulf conflict and Strait of Hormuz restrictions shifted trading patterns and extended voyage lengths, tightening market conditions
LEANER FLEET - Co operated 19 vessels at quarter-end, down from 29 a year earlier
